goal: Successfully book an Annual Health Checkup for spouse only
constraints: Use testdata values. Appointment date must be at least 5 days from today. Use plausible Indian names, cities, phone numbers.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

phases.description: Open conversation and state AHC intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has greeted and offered to book an appointment

phases.description: Select Only Spouse booking type and provide spouse details
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted valid spouse DOB and asked for appointment date
phases.recoveryHint: If spouse DOB is rejected (under 18), try an older date

phases.description: Provide appointment date and mobile number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted mobile number and asked for state
Bot confirms booking for the spouse

name: AHC Only Spouse happy flow
